specials.name: Avoidance
specials.description: Requirements The mindslaver mold is infecting a living or undead creature; Effect

specials.name: Infestation
specials.description: A mindslaver mold climbs onto and attaches itself to a willing or helpless creature. As long as the mold infests its host, the mold shares the same space as the host; this does not negatively impact the mold or its host. As long as the mold infests its host, the host takes a -3 status penalty on its Will save against the mold's dominate spell and the spell's duration becomes permanent as long as the mold remains attached. Each day, the host takes 1d4 points of void damage as the mold feeds on its bodily fluids. A mindslaver mold can be forcefully removed from its host with a successful Athletics check (DC 20) that deals 2d8 points of slashing damage to the host as the mold's tendrils rip free. A dead mindslaver mold deals no damage when forcefully removed.

specials.name: Mold Mindlink
specials.description: A mindslaver mold can communicate telepathically with any other mindslaver mold within 10 miles, and knows the conditions of of all other mindslaver molds in this area as the status spell.

specials.name: Spores
specials.description:
A creature hit by a mindslaver mold's sporepod must attempt a Will save.

Critical Failure The creature is stupefied 2.
Failure The creature is stupefied 1.
